1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path __while maintaining the device in a fixed axial position__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __and is introduced through the working channel after the device has been radially expanded and secured in position__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to treat neural tissue__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device is positioned to expand between tissue layers at a predetermined depth within the brain__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __at a location remote from the insertion point__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the integrity of the working channel__.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __by expanding an inner expandable element within the device__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __wherein the medical element is introduced after the inner expandable element has been expanded__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a surgical procedure through the reinforced working channel__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the reinforced working channel to treat the tissue__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that radial expansion occurs in a direction perpendicular to the tissue layer interface__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while preserving the working channel for continued access to the tissue__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __prior to introducing the medical element__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent __while the second expandable body remains expanded__; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __wherein the medical element is introduced while the second expandable body maintains radial pressure against the tissue__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __after completion of the medical procedure__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a surgical procedure within the working channel__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to treat the tissue__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the second expandable body expands perpendicular to the tissue layer interface__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __prior to introducing the medical element__.
